changelog: New voice command: say 'duplicate last sentence' or 'repeat last sentence' (or 'শেষ বাক্য ডুপ্লিকেট করো' / 'শেষ বাক্য আবার লিখো') alone while dictating and the last sentence is written again right after itself — handy for repeating a sentence for emphasis or a list line without re-dictating it. Undo removes just the copy, and the clipboard is never touched (71 commands in Help & Support > Voice commands). Nothing else changed — it never sends a message.
